name: Amami Souma
source:
The protagonist of the story. He has poor ties with his family and is thinking about moving out as soon as possible.

He got into a falling accident when he was little, but miraculously survived. Ever since then, he has had a strange symptom that lets him see through other people's lies.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
